title: Sorting and Searching Algorithms

content.text: Selection sort functions by repeatedly finding the minimum element and moving it to the front. Insertion sort is adaptive, building the sorted sequence incrementally. Merge sort utilizes a divide-and-conquer strategy to ensure stable O(n log n) performance.

Quick sort is highly efficient in practice but its performance is sensitive to the pivot selection. Searching techniques include Linear Search (scanning every element) and Binary Search, which requires a pre-sorted array to achieve logarithmic time complexity.
